column1: # What serves each entry of the inventory (mcp.tsv, web.tsv): one row per
#   entry        tool:<name>, argument:<tool>.<argument>, resource:<uri> or web:<path>
#   serves       operationId[?parameter], comma-separated; - with a ruling
#   parity       the parity case ids (test/parity/questions.json) that check it, comma-separated
#   ruling       - ; or, when serves is -, the owner's ruling, dated, that the
# TestInventoryIsServed fails on an entry with no row, a row with no entry,
# an operation, parameter or parity case that does not exist, and a ruling
# without a date. No exception without an owner ruling in this file.
